author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: woman on the left (circular head, round-topped flared dress, two legs) and man on the right (circular head, round-cornered torso, two legs), each head exactly 8 above its body top on centerlines (4 visible; the point under the head is the nearest body point); figures 10 apart. Follows full_body_ref.png's dress figure and the reference. The rejected drawing had a boxy stepped dress and a keyhole torso.
omissions: The reference's arm steps at the man's hips and the dress's straight shoulder slope are simplified; legs are straight and parallel rather than tapering.
drawing_plan: Heads r5 at (13,11)/(35,11); dress r4 cap from (13,24), sides to hem 6..19 at y=35, legs x 9/17; torso r3 corners x 29..42, y 24..35, legs x 31/39.
lucide_reference: Restroom-pictogram figures in the style of Lucide 'person-standing'; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png.
